title.zh: 马斯克称Colossus 2年底将部署120万块Blackwell，20万块专门跑推理
title.en: 马斯克称Colossus 2年底将部署120万块Blackwell，20万块专门跑推理

current_state.zh: Musk said xAI's Colossus 2 will deploy about 1.2 million Nvidia Blackwell GPUs by year-end, including roughly 200,000 GB300s dedicated to inference at a converted food warehouse.
